description: Reference definitions of CloudWatch alarms created by terraform/cloudwatch.tf. This file is documentation only — the actual alarms are managed by Terraform.

alarms.name: ${project_name}-unhealthy-hosts
alarms.purpose: Detects when the ALB sees fewer healthy targets than expected, analogous to multiple K8s pods failing readiness probes.

alarms.name: ${project_name}-running-task-count-low
alarms.purpose: Detects drift between desired and running ECS task counts, analogous to a ReplicaSet having fewer pods than desired.

event_rules.name: ${project_name}-ecs-task-stopped
event_rules.purpose: Immediate notification when any ECS task in the cluster stops, allowing the Auto-Healer to react in near real-time rather than waiting for the next alarm evaluation period.

event_rules.name: ${project_name}-chaos-schedule
event_rules.purpose: Periodically invokes the Chaos Injector Lambda to randomly terminate ECS tasks and validate self-healing.
